result.summary: The page layout is largely intact; only a minor text truncation issue was found on one of the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section appears truncated without an ellipsis style indicator, though this may be due to edge clipping rather than a text overflow bug.
